evidence_sources.title: Syllabus Secondary Stage (Phase I), Grade 9, Part 2 — Science, Mathematics, and Social Science
evidence_sources.evidence_locator: Science section, Work, Energy and Simple Machines; printed page 30 / PDF page index 31
evidence_sources.selection_reason: The official current Grade 9 science syllabus explicitly enumerates Work/Energy content and learning outcomes for the 2026-27 Grade 9 transition.
limitations: The PDF carries a DRAFT watermark while being published on the official NCERT site for 2026-27 planning; this authority record must be revalidated if CBSE/NCERT republishes a superseding version.

This source supports Grade 9 constant-force work, work-energy theorem, mechanical/kinetic/potential energy, free-fall PE-KE conversion, conservation of energy, and power; it does not support Grade 11 variable-force line-integral treatment.

excluded_extensions: Variable-force work as a line integral is not promoted into the Grade 9 scope.
Potential-energy gradients and advanced conservative-force formalism are not promoted into the Grade 9 scope.
Grade 11/JEE/Olympiad Work-Energy-Power material is not curriculum authority for this Grade 9 binding.
